notes: Geometry, APN, address and use code from the Alameda County assessor layer; lot size, units, year built, stories and building area from the City of Berkeley parcel layer (synchronized annually to the county roll), joined by APN. Owner names are not stored: ownerClass is derived from them (BART, City of Berkeley, other public, private). gisAreaSqFt is computed from the geometry in EPSG:2227.
